# IKEA Indonesia

> > IKEA Indonesia's official website offering affordable, well-designed furniture and home furnishings for every room including outdoor spaces, featuring collections like LÖVSKOGSLUND, ÅKERBÄR, and VINTERFINT.

IKEA Indonesia (ikea.co.id) serves as the local e-commerce and information portal for IKEA's furniture and home accessories in Indonesia. The site showcases product ranges from outdoor furniture to decorative items, helping customers create functional and stylish living spaces.

- Garden supplies
